Welcome to the Intel® Partner Alliance program!
Welcome to the Intel® Partner Alliance program!
We’re excited to have you join a unified ecosystem designed to enable partners to connect with the Intel ecosystem to accelerate innovative solutions that deliver business outcomes and unlock growth
To ensure uninterrupted access to your account,please log in within 45 days of receiving this email. Logging in will keep your profile active and tied to your company.
With benefits tailored to your business, you’ll be able to:
Drive new business opportunities with the latest tools, training, and resources Earn and redeem points on eligible purchases and activities Accelerate marketing and sales success with Market Development Funds Learn, prototype, and test workloads on the latest Intel® software Expand knowledge with world-class training in Intel® Partner University Create innovative products using NDA content, roadmaps, and developer tools Launch campaigns quickly with co-marketing assets on Intel® Marketing Studio Gain qualified leads with your partner storefront on Intel® Partner Showcase
